A project is an immutable chain of **revisions** (`revisions.ts`, `store.ts`); every revision traces to exact inputs and the engine release that built it; the last passing revision is always kept; revert = a new revision. Tables `CyrusProject`, `CyrusRevision` (a DB trigger keeps revisions immutable; smoke checks `cyrus_revision_immutable`), `CyrusProjectAsset`, `CyrusIdentifier`.
- **Namespaces and identifiers.** Each project reserves `nx_<hash>` at creation so ids, keys, permissions, sound keys, glyph codepoints and model paths are collision-free by construction (`identifiers.ts`; glyph block allocation for HUD fonts).
- **Plan gate.** `asset-gate.ts`: free/katara no assets, saka sound, all sound + texture; only create/edit is gated; fails closed.
- **Release record.** `release.ts`: engine release id (prompt version + sheets + rules + scanner hash + image digest), source/classpath/output hashes, scan report per build.
- **Compatibility.** Before r0 a "project" was a chain of `ModBuild` rows (`rootBuildId`/`baseBuildId`); both exist, the engine tables are additive (manual SQL `2026-10-10-cyrus-engine-core.sql`, **not applied** in production).
- Verified: unit + DB tests (`cyrus-engine-core`, `cyrus-engine-store-db`). Not verified: production data migration.

## Capability router and adapters
- **Router** (`engine-core/router.ts`, deterministic, no model): classifies what a request needs (plugin / plugin + resource pack / datapack / future client mod), discloses limits ("a vanilla client cannot show X"), applies the tier gate, and **downgrades instead of erroring**. The studio's separate broad-request router (`lib/cyrus/route.ts`, pure, zero API calls) routes prompts to games/categories/open mods.
- **Adapters** (`lib/cyrus/adapters`): the `GameAdapter` contract = artifact types and routes, toolchain + scanner, version list, knowledge source, **asset delivery per asset kind**, install rules, test lane, maturity (planned / template / beta / stable), route rules, optional `AssetProfile` (formats, channels, delivery, worker class, legal). Adapter #1 is Minecraft; `motion-minecraft.ts` lowers motion. Generated matrix: [reference/adapters.md](reference/adapters.md).
- **Per-game support packs** (`lib/cyrus/games/*.ts`, `GameSupport`): verified knowledge for Terraria, Valheim, Zomboid (and Palworld/Rust on WIP branches). These are knowledge + validators + compile harnesses only; those games are template previews in the UI and **on hold**.

## Version registry
`lib/cyrus/versions/registry.json` + `registry.ts`: the single source for JDK, pack formats (resource + data, major.minor), Paper API coordinate, **exact Paper server build and sha256 pin** (what Test Flight boots), capability flags (`legacyCustomModelData`, `dialogApi` ...), status (supported / preview / legacy / blocked) and `buildable`. Fail closed: a `null` pack number or missing server pin blocks the feature. Contract-tested against Paper's Fill API; a nightly check creates a "preview" row for new versions. Rendered table: [reference/versions.md](reference/versions.md). Facts: 1.21.1/1.21.4/1.21.8/1.21.11 build on JDK 21; 26.1.2 (build 74) and 26.2 (build 133) need JDK 25 and are **registered but not buildable** until the image has JDK 25 and an eval ran; 26.3 has only alpha/beta Paper builds, so it stays unpinned preview (an early research claim that 26.3 was stable was wrong and is corrected). `resourcePackClientVerified=false` everywhere: no real Minecraft client has loaded a Cyrus pack.

## Build pipeline and the build service
- **Service** `services/modbuilder` (Docker image on VM 88001; see [07 operations](07-operations.md)): `server.js` (HTTP), `prompts.js`, `route.js` (complexity routing, tiers), `precheck.js` + `rules/failure-rules.json` (18 reviewed rules), `sheets/` (per-version API sheets), `autofix.js` (deterministic fixes before a model repair), `scan.js` (bytecode + source safety scan), `jar.js` (reproducible jars: `jar --date`, sorted inputs), `release.js`, plus asset/designer/datapack/creature/config modules that bundle the `lib/cyrus` validators. Builds run Claude CLI with Read/Write/Edit only in a throwaway workspace, `javac --release N -proc:none` against a pre-resolved Paper-only classpath (Gradle only builds classpath files), no network for the model.
- **Models by tier**: Katara = Haiku class, Saka = Sonnet, Yakko = Opus (`MB_TIER_*`); complexity routing picks cheaper models for simple requests; repairs escalate one tier after two failed repairs. Knobs (all off by default): `MB_EFFORT`, `MB_CACHE_TTL`, `MB_DEDUPE`.
- **Portal side** `lib/modbuilder/create.ts` (`createModBuild`: validation, rate limits, 2-in-flight cap, token gate), `lib/cyrus/builder` (HTTP client), `lib/cyrus/follow.ts` (NDJSON re-attachable stream: stage -> `think`, `/live` draft -> `file`/`chunk`).
- **History**: service 0.3 (tuning) -> 0.4 (images the AI reads + live code) -> 0.5 (usage metering, auto-fixes, lean tools, cost knobs; branch only) -> 0.6 (networking capability manifest) -> r0+ (engine release record, asset/design/datapack/creature/config sections, catalog tools, designer no-model builds, legacy textures, JDK 25). Only 0.4 is running on VM 88001 per the last deploy; the rest requires the rebuild in the runbook.
- Verified: eval 28/28 built, 13/13 loaded on v6 (pre-programme); the programme added 178 eval prompts (harness built, **no paid run yet**). Not verified: AI output quality for texture/sound/datapack/import/designer/meshgen specs (no paid model build has run for them).

## Test Flight
`lib/cyrus/testflight` + `scripts` runner on node-2: a disposable Paper server per target version (pinned jar + sha256), boot, plugin enabled, RCON commands, `datapack list`, log matcher, clean shutdown; honest **per-check status table** (no "success" if a required stage was skipped); label "boot-tested" only where it ran. Measured: 26.x boots in about 10.4-10.8 s (722-803 MB RSS), 1.21.11 on JDK 21 in 18 s (878 MB); a whole flight 12-35 s. The **gate** (`CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_GATE`, worker sweep) flies each succeeded build; `CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_BLOCK_ON_FAIL` refuses installs of failed builds. One flight at a time (node-2 build lock); no container limits yet. Real flight records live in `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/*flights*.json` ([09 testing](09-testing-and-verification.md)).

## Delivery orchestrator and rollback
`lib/cyrus/delivery` + `lib/cyrus/assets` + worker: journaled install / update / uninstall of a jar, resource pack, data pack, worldgen pack or Mod Pack as one unit, through the existing Mods engine (`GameMod` source `cyrus` + `ServerMod` + worker `GAME_MOD_SYNC`; state file on the guest, backup, staged write, rollback). Honest states `rolled_back` and `rollback_incomplete`; Mod Packs re-check conflicts against the live server inside the orchestrator. Enqueue API `POST /api/cyrus/delivery/v1` (same checks as install, restart/worldgen acknowledgements, idempotency key, one job per server): contract in [CYRUS-DELIVERY-API.md](../CYRUS-DELIVERY-API.md). Flags `CYRUS_DELIVERY`, `CYRUS_DATAPACK_DELIVERY_REAL`, `CYRUS_MODPACK_INSTALL_REAL`, `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL`. Verified on real node-2 Paper: install, update, a deliberately broken update rolled back, uninstall, worldgen rollback, and (r38) a revoke mid-update that first failed to roll back (bug found and fixed) then restored exact bytes. Not verified: any customer server (by rule).

## Managed plugins, Pack Loader, pack hosting
- **Managed plugins** (`lib/cyrus/managed`, tables `CyrusManagedPlugin`, `CyrusServerManagedPlugin`): plugins Nxeon installs because Cyrus mods depend on them, pinned per Minecraft family, ref-counted, not removable while depended on. Hosts the **Nxeon Pack Loader** and **BetterModel 3.5.0** (MIT). Seed script `scripts/cyrus-seed-managed-plugins.ts`.
- **Pack Loader**: sends N packs by UUID with `addResourcePack`, per-pack required/optional, accept-rate telemetry, Geyser/Floodgate detection; `server.properties` only as a fallback (it holds just one pack). The conflict engine detects an existing pack owner (ResourcePackManager, Oraxen, Nexo).
- **Pack hosting** (`lib/cyrus/packhost`): content-addressed immutable URLs `/p/<sha1>.zip`, size caps (`CYRUS_PACK_MAX_BYTES`), retention GC, local or S3-compatible store (`CYRUS_PACK_STORE`); production with nothing configured has NO store (fail closed). The provider is not named to customers. Provider/domain choice is an open owner action.

## Conflict engine and Mod Packs
- **Inventory** (`lib/cyrus/inventory`): read-only scan of jars' descriptors (bytecode summary, plugin.yml, Fabric/Quilt/Forge/NeoForge descriptors), `server.properties`, datapacks, existing pack owners.
- **Static conflict engine** (`lib/cyrus/conflicts`, pure and deterministic: same input gives a byte-identical report): plugin names, commands/aliases (incl. Brigadier roots), permissions, depend/softdepend DAG, api-version/Java/Folia, events and priorities, NamespacedKey/PDC keys, legacy `custom_model_data` ints and `item_model` keys, recipe keys, sound keys, single-owner resources (Vault providers, chat, tab, sidebar), datapack `replace:true`, pack whole-file overrides, font codepoint overlap, budget classes. Severity: blocking / warn / info. Reserved namespaces prevent most clashes. A mutation corpus (take a good mod, collide IDs) tests catches.
- **Mod Packs** (`lib/cyrus/modpack`, API `/api/cyrus/modpacks/v1`, `CYRUS_MODPACKS`): an Nxeon manifest shaped like mrpack (files with path/sha1/sha512/downloads/env, override dirs, platform=paper); third-party jars by URL + hash, only Cyrus-built artifacts embedded; versioned; compatibility matrix; installs and rolls back as one unit; never contains Paper/vanilla jars. **Every open warning must be acknowledged** to install (owner recommendation applied, r29). Not plan-gated. r32 fix: pack create/install now enforce the same networking-consent and Test Flight gates as single installs. UI screens exist (r31).

## Import your own mod
`lib/cyrus/import` + `services/modbuilder/import.js`: source-only. Copies `src/main/{java,resources}`, ignores the uploader's build files (their build is never run), compiles with the service template and a **curated checksum-pinned dependency allowlist** (`import/deps.json`; first-class integrations Vault, LuckPerms, PlaceholderAPI). Unsupported: Kotlin, Lombok, annotation processors. Ingestion limits (zip-slip, zip-bomb ratio, nested jars, multi-release, class major), no execution at ingestion, ownership attestation record, detected licence, public sharing hard-off. Two scan profiles: strict for generated, **attested/imported** with warnings and no "safe" claim. Imported source becomes revision 0 and uses the same change planner, tests, versions and install path. Jar-only imports are analysis only. Not plan-gated (model use and assets follow tokens and gates). Flag `cyrus_import_enabled`. Fixed: import refused 1.21.9+ data packs (r31).

## Data packs and worldgen
`lib/cyrus/datapack`, `services/modbuilder/{datapack-spec,datapacks}.js`, `scripts/cyrus/datapack-derive.py`: a typed spec compiled by per-version emitters (the AI never hand-writes JSON); schema source vanilla-mcdoc (MIT); static validation (including a command allowlist and `line_continuation` refusal) then a real headless Paper over RCON. Content: recipes, loot tables, advancements, tags, functions, enchantments. **Worldgen** (R4: custom dimensions, biomes, structures; `CYRUS_WORLDGEN`): `/reload` does not reload worldgen, so these need a restart and a **broken worldgen pack stops a server at its next start**; hence delivery rollback is mandatory. Spans four datapack schemas and two `pack.mcmeta` styles (`min_format/max_format` from 1.21.9). Verified: worldgen showcase passed on 1.21.1/1.21.4/1.21.8/1.21.11/26.1.2/26.2; broken files each alone (validator 8/8, server refuses to start 7/8). Flags `CYRUS_DATAPACK_STUDIO`, `CYRUS_WORLDGEN`.

## Creatures
`lib/cyrus/creature` + `services/modbuilder/creatures.js` (`CYRUS_CREATURES`): `RigSpec` (3 archetypes, 5 procedural clips, 32 bones/creature, 4 creatures per server caps) compiled to a Blockbench `.bbmodel` for **BetterModel 3.5.0** (managed plugin, needs Java 25, so animated creatures are 26.x first; 1.21.x gets a vanilla-model mob with custom skin + full sound set, e.g. the banshee). Base vanilla mob supplies hitbox/AI; display entities carry the bones. Do not embed Blockbench (GPL). Verified on real Paper 26.2: load, pack hand-off + Pack Loader, malformed models, perf ramp 1/10/50; r30: creature paint is byte-identical inside BetterModel's pack. Not verified: how it looks or animates in a real client.

## Gameplay designers
All behind `CYRUS_DESIGNER` (+ `CYRUS_DESIGNER_BUILDS` for no-model builds). Design files live in `assets/designs/<id>.json` with a top-level `kind`; the compiler (`lib/cyrus/designer`, 39 files) emits a complete Paper plugin from a **verified Java component library**; every number/text becomes a `config.yml` setting, so edits change config only (proved with a config migration on real servers). Static + runtime **Budget** caps, no `run_command`, no arbitrary scripts. Javadoc/escape injection fixed in r32 (AC-3).
- **Item + ability graph (R3)**: 10 triggers, 11 conditions, 21 actions, 17-component library.
- **Menu + quest (R3)**: chest menus (click/drag cancel hardening, pagination, item/XP/Vault money prices, permissions, dialogues), quests (chains, 7 objective kinds, branches, daily/weekly, per-player progress in PDC).
- **Boss + encounter (R4)**: 20 vanilla bases, 1-5 one-way phases, up to 8 telegraphed attacks, arena (leash, enrage), boss bar, capped minions, drops by damage share, wave encounters; never persistent, no griefing.
- **HUD + glyphs (R4)**: action bar, per-player boss bars, per-player sidebar (never replaces another plugin's), plus the mod's own font `<ns>:hud` with codepoints from the identifier registry; 15 glyph presets; no shaders, no free positioning (the router says so).
- Verified by Test Flight RCON on 1.21.11 (JDK 21) and 26.2 (JDK 25): item, menu/quest, boss (55 RCON + 2 log checks), HUD (22 checks); scripted Mineflayer player 5/5 for the boss. Not verified: a real client seeing menus/HUD/bosses; other versions have no javac classpath for designers.
- **Designer edits reach servers (r31)**: no-model designer builds (config.yml-only = the base jar repacked with only config.yml changed; structural = javac) + delivery; real flight: edit -> build -> deliver -> RCON shows cooldown 100 and config migrated v1 -> v2. Image rebuild needed before enabling.

## Item model states and display contexts
`lib/cyrus/itemmodel` (`CYRUS_ITEM_STATES`): `ItemModelSpec` v1 with per-category defaults for **8 display contexts** (gui, ground, item frame, first/third person hands, head) and named STATES (bow pull stages, gun aim/reload) selected by 1.21.4+ item model definitions (`condition`, `range_dispatch`, `select`, plugin-set custom_model_data flags). No free animation (frame animation via `.mcmeta`, fast model switching). Vanilla-verified emitter and a real node-2 runner (javac 1.21.11 + 26.2, strict scan, Test Flight self-check, component round trip). The handgun grip default sits about 2/16 block off the hand in third person; the proposed fix is `CYRUS_HANDGUN_GRIP_FIX` (off, changes shipped packs, owner's call).

## Config and stats core
`lib/cyrus/config` (`CYRUS_CONFIG_STUDIO`): `ConfigSpec` v1 (12 param types, hard limits vs a "balanced" band, units, `applies` live/reload/restart, `visual` viewport links, presets), 12 category templates as data (mob, melee, gun, armor, ability, boss, shop, quest ...), the AI declares tunables and the build verifies they are read, **values-only revisions** delivered through the orchestrator (no model, no build), schema inference for imported mods. Real flights on 1.21.11 + 26.2; the "send to server" API returned 501 until the worker path landed (r31 closed it for designers). UI: [03 studios](03-studios.md).

## Motion core
`lib/cyrus/motion` (game-neutral, pure; plan: [motion/MOTION-PLAN.md](motion/MOTION-PLAN.md)): `MotionSpec` v1 with typed tracks (transform, particle, sound-cue, light/material, event/state-machine), deterministic `sample`, analytic seeded particles, a state-machine runner, simulation + event log, structured validation against a game capability's caps. 9 presets (gun fire, gun fire/reload/cock machine, hinged door, parametric humanoid/quadruped/floating gait generators, muzzle flash, explosion, fire, smoke, water splash). **Minecraft lowering** = designer kind `motion`: display-entity interpolation segments, step snaps, particle births, sound keys. Vehicles are explicitly NOT a Minecraft target (the core can express them; the build waits for a vehicle game). Real flights 39/39 RCON on 1.21.11 + 26.2; headless software-rasteriser sheets for review. Not verified: any look in a real client; studio timeline/preview build-out is future work.

## AI mesh (meshgen) and Blender
`lib/cyrus/meshgen` + `blender/` (`CYRUS_MESHGEN`, `CYRUS_MESHGEN_SCRATCH`; layer 4 of Model Studio): Zod specs for templates (rifle, crate, sword), a parts kit (10 shapes), a deterministic router over a **cost ladder** (rung 0 template ... rung 3 scratch script behind an AST guard), run headless in Blender 5.2.2 LTS inside a transient systemd sandbox (no network, user nobody, read-only fs, memory/CPU/task caps, build lock). Real node-2 flights accepted rifle/crate templates (1.4-2.5k triangles in about 26-29 s). Estimate-first job route + durable file queue + 30 s worker tick; the r32 driver-expression scan bypass (AC-2) is fixed. Not verified: a real model call, LODs, in-engine load, kernel escape (a microVM/gVisor is required before scratch scripts), an isolated GPU/worker; "drum magazine looks like a wheel"; parts overlap rather than union. Layer-3 meshes have **no export target** (no supported game takes glTF).

## Playtest bots, Server Doctor, health telemetry
- **Playtest** (`lib/cyrus/playtest`, `CYRUS_PLAYTEST`): a ModSpec's functional acceptance tests compile deterministically into a plan of 14 step kinds run by a Mineflayer bot inside Test Flight; verdict kept apart from the boot verdict. Ran on 1.21.11: a good fixture passed 6/6 and a deliberately broken one failed exactly the right checks. Other versions are refused, not skipped. Generated builds store no ModSpec yet, so playtest reports "not run" for them.
- **Server Doctor** (`lib/cyrus/doctor`, `CYRUS_SERVER_DOCTOR`, admin-only read-only API): server facts, plugin/mod inventory, conflicts, problems, warnings. Tested on a throwaway server seeded with a conflict, a throwing plugin, a legacy plugin and a Fabric mod; never run on a customer server.
- **Telemetry** (`lib/cyrus/telemetry`, `CYRUS_HEALTH_TELEMETRY`): opt-in, aggregate-only signals, retention; signed ingest answers 503 until the DRAFT tables exist; no collector exists. Open security items O-1 (replay) before enabling.

## Try It server
`lib/cyrus/tryit` (`CYRUS_TRY_IT`, `CYRUS_TRY_IT_EXPOSE`): a throwaway Paper server on node-2 with caps and auto teardown so a visitor can try a mod. Real flight: create -> pack served -> RCON -> a second session refused -> teardown. **Not public**: needs the firewall range 47200-47299 and DNS.

## Multi-version builds and the 1.21.1 legacy path
- `lib/cyrus/matrix` (`CYRUS_BUILD_MATRIX`): one design builds for several versions; real per-version compile + flight on 1.21.1/1.21.4/1.21.8/1.21.11 all passed; 26.2 refused as preview. Not wired into the builds route or stored yet.
- Legacy 1.21.1 item looks (`CYRUS_LEGACY_TEXTURES` portal, `MB_LEGACY_TEXTURES` service): custom model data on 52 vanilla-verified carriers, pack format 34, damage states only, every other limit shown; real Paper 1.21.1 flight 6/6. No real client.

## Mod capabilities: networking and AI
`lib/cyrus/capabilities.ts` + `services/modbuilder/capabilities.js` (default OFF, setting `cyrus_mod_networking_enabled`): a mod that wants the network ships an `nx-capabilities.yml` manifest (declared host allow-list, anti-SSRF via the NxHttp wrapper), the customer consents at install, and AI calls go through the Nxeon AI gateway (`lib/cyrus/ai-gateway*.ts`, a budgeted stub that never calls a model yet; gateway token expiry is open item O-2).

## Mod lifecycle
`lib/cyrus/lifecycle` + worker sweeps: install plans, on/off, broken/outdated detection (`cyrus-compat-watch`), updates, creator warnings. Game-version rules come from `GameSupport`.

## Eval harness
`lib/cyrus/eval`, `scripts/cyrus/eval-run.ts`, `services/modbuilder/eval/`: 178 prompts in categories with a per-version matrix and scoring spec; one-command runner with dry run, budget cap (required for a real run), resume, stage scoring, `baseline.json` + `report.md`. First run planned: 90 builds on 1.21.11 at Saka tier, estimated $9.73-$22.23. **No paid run has happened**; tested only against a fake CLI. See [09 testing](09-testing-and-verification.md).

Rendered table: [reference/versions.md](reference/versions.md). Facts: 1.21.1/1.21.4/1.21.8/1.21.11 build on JDK 21; 26.1.2 (build 74) and 26.2 (build 133) need JDK 25 and are **registered but not buildable** until the image has JDK 25 and an eval ran; 26.3 has only alpha/beta Paper builds, so it stays unpinned preview (an early research claim that 26.3 was stable was wrong and is corrected). `resourcePackClientVerified=false` everywhere: no real Minecraft client has loaded a Cyrus pack.

## Build pipeline and the build service
- **Service** `services/modbuilder` (Docker image on VM 88001; see [07 operations](07-operations.md)): `server.js` (HTTP), `prompts.js`, `route.js` (complexity routing, tiers), `precheck.js` + `rules/failure-rules.json` (18 reviewed rules), `sheets/` (per-version API sheets), `autofix.js` (deterministic fixes before a model repair), `scan.js` (bytecode + source safety scan), `jar.js` (reproducible jars: `jar --date`, sorted inputs), `release.js`, plus asset/designer/datapack/creature/config modules that bundle the `lib/cyrus` validators. Builds run Claude CLI with Read/Write/Edit only in a throwaway workspace, `javac --release N -proc:none` against a pre-resolved Paper-only classpath (Gradle only builds classpath files), no network for the model.
- **Models by tier**: Katara = Haiku class, Saka = Sonnet, Yakko = Opus (`MB_TIER_*`); complexity routing picks cheaper models for simple requests; repairs escalate one tier after two failed repairs. Knobs (all off by default): `MB_EFFORT`, `MB_CACHE_TTL`, `MB_DEDUPE`.
- **Portal side** `lib/modbuilder/create.ts` (`createModBuild`: validation, rate limits, 2-in-flight cap, token gate), `lib/cyrus/builder` (HTTP client), `lib/cyrus/follow.ts` (NDJSON re-attachable stream: stage -> `think`, `/live` draft -> `file`/`chunk`).
- **History**: service 0.3 (tuning) -> 0.4 (images the AI reads + live code) -> 0.5 (usage metering, auto-fixes, lean tools, cost knobs; branch only) -> 0.6 (networking capability manifest) -> r0+ (engine release record, asset/design/datapack/creature/config sections, catalog tools, designer no-model builds, legacy textures, JDK 25). Only 0.4 is running on VM 88001 per the last deploy; the rest requires the rebuild in the runbook.
- Verified: eval 28/28 built, 13/13 loaded on v6 (pre-programme); the programme added 178 eval prompts (harness built, **no paid run yet**). Not verified: AI output quality for texture/sound/datapack/import/designer/meshgen specs (no paid model build has run for them).

## Test Flight
`lib/cyrus/testflight` + `scripts` runner on node-2: a disposable Paper server per target version (pinned jar + sha256), boot, plugin enabled, RCON commands, `datapack list`, log matcher, clean shutdown; honest **per-check status table** (no "success" if a required stage was skipped); label "boot-tested" only where it ran. Measured: 26.x boots in about 10.4-10.8 s (722-803 MB RSS), 1.21.11 on JDK 21 in 18 s (878 MB); a whole flight 12-35 s. The **gate** (`CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_GATE`, worker sweep) flies each succeeded build; `CYRUS_TESTFLIGHT_BLOCK_ON_FAIL` refuses installs of failed builds. One flight at a time (node-2 build lock); no container limits yet. Real flight records live in `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/*flights*.json` ([09 testing](09-testing-and-verification.md)).

## Delivery orchestrator and rollback
`lib/cyrus/delivery` + `lib/cyrus/assets` + worker: journaled install / update / uninstall of a jar, resource pack, data pack, worldgen pack or Mod Pack as one unit, through the existing Mods engine (`GameMod` source `cyrus` + `ServerMod` + worker `GAME_MOD_SYNC`; state file on the guest, backup, staged write, rollback). Honest states `rolled_back` and `rollback_incomplete`; Mod Packs re-check conflicts against the live server inside the orchestrator. Enqueue API `POST /api/cyrus/delivery/v1` (same checks as install, restart/worldgen acknowledgements, idempotency key, one job per server): contract in [CYRUS-DELIVERY-API.md](../CYRUS-DELIVERY-API.md). Flags `CYRUS_DELIVERY`, `CYRUS_DATAPACK_DELIVERY_REAL`, `CYRUS_MODPACK_INSTALL_REAL`, `CYRUS_MANAGED_PLUGINS_REAL`. Verified on real node-2 Paper: install, update, a deliberately broken update rolled back, uninstall, worldgen rollback, and (r38) a revoke mid-update that first failed to roll back (bug found and fixed) then restored exact bytes. Not verified: any customer server (by rule).

## Managed plugins, Pack Loader, pack hosting
- **Managed plugins** (`lib/cyrus/managed`, tables `CyrusManagedPlugin`, `CyrusServerManagedPlugin`): plugins Nxeon installs because Cyrus mods depend on them, pinned per Minecraft family, ref-counted, not removable while depended on. Hosts the **Nxeon Pack Loader** and **BetterModel 3.5.0** (MIT). Seed script `scripts/cyrus-seed-managed-plugins.ts`.
- **Pack Loader**: sends N packs by UUID with `addResourcePack`, per-pack required/optional, accept-rate telemetry, Geyser/Floodgate detection; `server.properties` only as a fallback (it holds just one pack). The conflict engine detects an existing pack owner (ResourcePackManager, Oraxen, Nexo).
- **Pack hosting** (`lib/cyrus/packhost`): content-addressed immutable URLs `/p/<sha1>.zip`, size caps (`CYRUS_PACK_MAX_BYTES`), retention GC, local or S3-compatible store (`CYRUS_PACK_STORE`); production with nothing configured has NO store (fail closed). The provider is not named to customers. Provider/domain choice is an open owner action.

## Conflict engine and Mod Packs
- **Inventory** (`lib/cyrus/inventory`): read-only scan of jars' descriptors (bytecode summary, plugin.yml, Fabric/Quilt/Forge/NeoForge descriptors), `server.properties`, datapacks, existing pack owners.
- **Static conflict engine** (`lib/cyrus/conflicts`, pure and deterministic: same input gives a byte-identical report): plugin names, commands/aliases (incl. Brigadier roots), permissions, depend/softdepend DAG, api-version/Java/Folia, events and priorities, NamespacedKey/PDC keys, legacy `custom_model_data` ints and `item_model` keys, recipe keys, sound keys, single-owner resources (Vault providers, chat, tab, sidebar), datapack `replace:true`, pack whole-file overrides, font codepoint overlap, budget classes. Severity: blocking / warn / info. Reserved namespaces prevent most clashes. A mutation corpus (take a good mod, collide IDs) tests catches.
- **Mod Packs** (`lib/cyrus/modpack`, API `/api/cyrus/modpacks/v1`, `CYRUS_MODPACKS`): an Nxeon manifest shaped like mrpack (files with path/sha1/sha512/downloads/env, override dirs, platform=paper); third-party jars by URL + hash, only Cyrus-built artifacts embedded; versioned; compatibility matrix; installs and rolls back as one unit; never contains Paper/vanilla jars. **Every open warning must be acknowledged** to install (owner recommendation applied, r29). Not plan-gated. r32 fix: pack create/install now enforce the same networking-consent and Test Flight gates as single installs. UI screens exist (r31).

## Import your own mod
`lib/cyrus/import` + `services/modbuilder/import.js`: source-only. Copies `src/main/{java,resources}`, ignores the uploader's build files (their build is never run), compiles with the service template and a **curated checksum-pinned dependency allowlist** (`import/deps.json`; first-class integrations Vault, LuckPerms, PlaceholderAPI). Unsupported: Kotlin, Lombok, annotation processors. Ingestion limits (zip-slip, zip-bomb ratio, nested jars, multi-release, class major), no execution at ingestion, ownership attestation record, detected licence, public sharing hard-off. Two scan profiles: strict for generated, **attested/imported** with warnings and no "safe" claim. Imported source becomes revision 0 and uses the same change planner, tests, versions and install path. Jar-only imports are analysis only. Not plan-gated (model use and assets follow tokens and gates). Flag `cyrus_import_enabled`. Fixed: import refused 1.21.9+ data packs (r31).

## Data packs and worldgen
`lib/cyrus/datapack`, `services/modbuilder/{datapack-spec,datapacks}.js`, `scripts/cyrus/datapack-derive.py`: a typed spec compiled by per-version emitters (the AI never hand-writes JSON); schema source vanilla-mcdoc (MIT); static validation (including a command allowlist and `line_continuation` refusal) then a real headless Paper over RCON. Content: recipes, loot tables, advancements, tags, functions, enchantments. **Worldgen** (R4: custom dimensions, biomes, structures; `CYRUS_WORLDGEN`): `/reload` does not reload worldgen, so these need a restart and a **broken worldgen pack stops a server at its next start**; hence delivery rollback is mandatory. Spans four datapack schemas and two `pack.mcmeta` styles (`min_format/max_format` from 1.21.9). Verified: worldgen showcase passed on 1.21.1/1.21.4/1.21.8/1.21.11/26.1.2/26.2; broken files each alone (validator 8/8, server refuses to start 7/8). Flags `CYRUS_DATAPACK_STUDIO`, `CYRUS_WORLDGEN`.

## Creatures
`lib/cyrus/creature` + `services/modbuilder/creatures.js` (`CYRUS_CREATURES`): `RigSpec` (3 archetypes, 5 procedural clips, 32 bones/creature, 4 creatures per server caps) compiled to a Blockbench `.bbmodel` for **BetterModel 3.5.0** (managed plugin, needs Java 25, so animated creatures are 26.x first; 1.21.x gets a vanilla-model mob with custom skin + full sound set, e.g. the banshee). Base vanilla mob supplies hitbox/AI; display entities carry the bones. Do not embed Blockbench (GPL). Verified on real Paper 26.2: load, pack hand-off + Pack Loader, malformed models, perf ramp 1/10/50; r30: creature paint is byte-identical inside BetterModel's pack. Not verified: how it looks or animates in a real client.

## Gameplay designers
All behind `CYRUS_DESIGNER` (+ `CYRUS_DESIGNER_BUILDS` for no-model builds). Design files live in `assets/designs/<id>.json` with a top-level `kind`; the compiler (`lib/cyrus/designer`, 39 files) emits a complete Paper plugin from a **verified Java component library**; every number/text becomes a `config.yml` setting, so edits change config only (proved with a config migration on real servers). Static + runtime **Budget** caps, no `run_command`, no arbitrary scripts. Javadoc/escape injection fixed in r32 (AC-3).
- **Item + ability graph (R3)**: 10 triggers, 11 conditions, 21 actions, 17-component library.
- **Menu + quest (R3)**: chest menus (click/drag cancel hardening, pagination, item/XP/Vault money prices, permissions, dialogues), quests (chains, 7 objective kinds, branches, daily/weekly, per-player progress in PDC).
- **Boss + encounter (R4)**: 20 vanilla bases, 1-5 one-way phases, up to 8 telegraphed attacks, arena (leash, enrage), boss bar, capped minions, drops by damage share, wave encounters; never persistent, no griefing.
- **HUD + glyphs (R4)**: action bar, per-player boss bars, per-player sidebar (never replaces another plugin's), plus the mod's own font `<ns>:hud` with codepoints from the identifier registry; 15 glyph presets; no shaders, no free positioning (the router says so).
- Verified by Test Flight RCON on 1.21.11 (JDK 21) and 26.2 (JDK 25): item, menu/quest, boss (55 RCON + 2 log checks), HUD (22 checks); scripted Mineflayer player 5/5 for the boss. Not verified: a real client seeing menus/HUD/bosses; other versions have no javac classpath for designers.
- **Designer edits reach servers (r31)**: no-model designer builds (config.yml-only = the base jar repacked with only config.yml changed; structural = javac) + delivery; real flight: edit -> build -> deliver -> RCON shows cooldown 100 and config migrated v1 -> v2. Image rebuild needed before enabling.

## Item model states and display contexts
`lib/cyrus/itemmodel` (`CYRUS_ITEM_STATES`): `ItemModelSpec` v1 with per-category defaults for **8 display contexts** (gui, ground, item frame, first/third person hands, head) and named STATES (bow pull stages, gun aim/reload) selected by 1.21.4+ item model definitions (`condition`, `range_dispatch`, `select`, plugin-set custom_model_data flags). No free animation (frame animation via `.mcmeta`, fast model switching). Vanilla-verified emitter and a real node-2 runner (javac 1.21.11 + 26.2, strict scan, Test Flight self-check, component round trip). The handgun grip default sits about 2/16 block off the hand in third person; the proposed fix is `CYRUS_HANDGUN_GRIP_FIX` (off, changes shipped packs, owner's call).

## Config and stats core
`lib/cyrus/config` (`CYRUS_CONFIG_STUDIO`): `ConfigSpec` v1 (12 param types, hard limits vs a "balanced" band, units, `applies` live/reload/restart, `visual` viewport links, presets), 12 category templates as data (mob, melee, gun, armor, ability, boss, shop, quest ...), the AI declares tunables and the build verifies they are read, **values-only revisions** delivered through the orchestrator (no model, no build), schema inference for imported mods. Real flights on 1.21.11 + 26.2; the "send to server" API returned 501 until the worker path landed (r31 closed it for designers). UI: [03 studios](03-studios.md).

## Motion core
`lib/cyrus/motion` (game-neutral, pure; plan: [motion/MOTION-PLAN.md](motion/MOTION-PLAN.md)): `MotionSpec` v1 with typed tracks (transform, particle, sound-cue, light/material, event/state-machine), deterministic `sample`, analytic seeded particles, a state-machine runner, simulation + event log, structured validation against a game capability's caps. 9 presets (gun fire, gun fire/reload/cock machine, hinged door, parametric humanoid/quadruped/floating gait generators, muzzle flash, explosion, fire, smoke, water splash). **Minecraft lowering** = designer kind `motion`: display-entity interpolation segments, step snaps, particle births, sound keys. Vehicles are explicitly NOT a Minecraft target (the core can express them; the build waits for a vehicle game). Real flights 39/39 RCON on 1.21.11 + 26.2; headless software-rasteriser sheets for review. Not verified: any look in a real client; studio timeline/preview build-out is future work.

## AI mesh (meshgen) and Blender
`lib/cyrus/meshgen` + `blender/` (`CYRUS_MESHGEN`, `CYRUS_MESHGEN_SCRATCH`; layer 4 of Model Studio): Zod specs for templates (rifle, crate, sword), a parts kit (10 shapes), a deterministic router over a **cost ladder** (rung 0 template ... rung 3 scratch script behind an AST guard), run headless in Blender 5.2.2 LTS inside a transient systemd sandbox (no network, user nobody, read-only fs, memory/CPU/task caps, build lock). Real node-2 flights accepted rifle/crate templates (1.4-2.5k triangles in about 26-29 s). Estimate-first job route + durable file queue + 30 s worker tick; the r32 driver-expression scan bypass (AC-2) is fixed. Not verified: a real model call, LODs, in-engine load, kernel escape (a microVM/gVisor is required before scratch scripts), an isolated GPU/worker; "drum magazine looks like a wheel"; parts overlap rather than union. Layer-3 meshes have **no export target** (no supported game takes glTF).

## Playtest bots, Server Doctor, health telemetry
- **Playtest** (`lib/cyrus/playtest`, `CYRUS_PLAYTEST`): a ModSpec's functional acceptance tests compile deterministically into a plan of 14 step kinds run by a Mineflayer bot inside Test Flight; verdict kept apart from the boot verdict. Ran on 1.21.11: a good fixture passed 6/6 and a deliberately broken one failed exactly the right checks. Other versions are refused, not skipped. Generated builds store no ModSpec yet, so playtest reports "not run" for them.
- **Server Doctor** (`lib/cyrus/doctor`, `CYRUS_SERVER_DOCTOR`, admin-only read-only API): server facts, plugin/mod inventory, conflicts, problems, warnings. Tested on a throwaway server seeded with a conflict, a throwing plugin, a legacy plugin and a Fabric mod; never run on a customer server.
- **Telemetry** (`lib/cyrus/telemetry`, `CYRUS_HEALTH_TELEMETRY`): opt-in, aggregate-only signals, retention; signed ingest answers 503 until the DRAFT tables exist; no collector exists. Open security items O-1 (replay) before enabling.

## Try It server
`lib/cyrus/tryit` (`CYRUS_TRY_IT`, `CYRUS_TRY_IT_EXPOSE`): a throwaway Paper server on node-2 with caps and auto teardown so a visitor can try a mod. Real flight: create -> pack served -> RCON -> a second session refused -> teardown. **Not public**: needs the firewall range 47200-47299 and DNS.

## Multi-version builds and the 1.21.1 legacy path
- `lib/cyrus/matrix` (`CYRUS_BUILD_MATRIX`): one design builds for several versions; real per-version compile + flight on 1.21.1/1.21.4/1.21.8/1.21.11 all passed; 26.2 refused as preview. Not wired into the builds route or stored yet.
- Legacy 1.21.1 item looks (`CYRUS_LEGACY_TEXTURES` portal, `MB_LEGACY_TEXTURES` service): custom model data on 52 vanilla-verified carriers, pack format 34, damage states only, every other limit shown; real Paper 1.21.1 flight 6/6. No real client.

## Mod capabilities: networking and AI
`lib/cyrus/capabilities.ts` + `services/modbuilder/capabilities.js` (default OFF, setting `cyrus_mod_networking_enabled`): a mod that wants the network ships an `nx-capabilities.yml` manifest (declared host allow-list, anti-SSRF via the NxHttp wrapper), the customer consents at install, and AI calls go through the Nxeon AI gateway (`lib/cyrus/ai-gateway*.ts`, a budgeted stub that never calls a model yet; gateway token expiry is open item O-2).

## Mod lifecycle
`lib/cyrus/lifecycle` + worker sweeps: install plans, on/off, broken/outdated detection (`cyrus-compat-watch`), updates, creator warnings. Game-version rules come from `GameSupport`.

## Eval harness
`lib/cyrus/eval`, `scripts/cyrus/eval-run.ts`, `services/modbuilder/eval/`: 178 prompts in categories with a per-version matrix and scoring spec; one-command runner with dry run, budget cap (required for a real run), resume, stage scoring, `baseline.json` + `report.md`. First run planned: 90 builds on 1.21.11 at Saka tier, estimated $9.73-$22.23. **No paid run has happened**; tested only against a fake CLI. See [09 testing](09-testing-and-verification.md).

# 03 Studios and designer UIs

The studios are full-page editors over the same mod project (revisions). They are **built** (merged into `feature/cyrus-r2`), behind plan gates and switches, and shown on node-2 with fixtures; **none has been reviewed by the owner against a real client**, and several follow mockups the owner has not reviewed (v2, v3, v4, v5 in `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-designs/`). Shared rules: plan gates are enforced **server side** (the UI only mirrors them), editor saves survive builds via a 3-way merge (human wins), every number shown comes from real runs, and each studio has dark, light and phone layouts.

Who sees what (`lib/cyrus/studios/access.ts`): `cyrusUser && (previewUser || flagOn)`; switches `cyrus_studios_enabled` (texture + sound), `cyrus_model_studio_enabled`, `cyrus_model_editor_enabled`, `CYRUS_DESIGNER`, `CYRUS_CONFIG_STUDIO`.

| Studio | Route | Plan | State |
|---|---|---|---|
| Studio shell + locked states | `/dashboard/cyrus/<id>/studio` | per studio | built (r5) |
| Texture Studio | `.../studio/texture` | All models | built (r5, r10 states) |
| Sound Studio | `.../studio/sound` | Saka and up | built (r9) |
| Model Studio layer 1: viewport + paint | `.../studio/model` | All models | built (r16, r30) |
| Model Studio layer 2: cuboid + bone editor + timeline | same | All models | built (r17, r30) |
| Model Studio layer 3: mesh retexture + light edit | `.../studio/mesh` | All models | built (r30), export disabled |
| Motion panel | `.../studio/motion` | designers: not plan-gated | built (r27), mockup unreviewed |
| Item / Menu+Quest / Boss designers | `.../studio/items`, `menus`, `bosses` | not plan-gated | built (r27) |
| Config and Stats Studio | `.../studio/config` | recommended ungated | built (r23) |
| Mod Packs, Import, Data Pack screens | customer app | not plan-gated | built (r31), read-only data pack |
| Library browser | studio side panel | follows the studio gate | built (r31) |
| Creature studio | (UI) | All models | **not built** (backend only) |
| Forge / modules (mod structure) | graph sub-branches, modules | n/a | **pending** (r45, unmerged) |

## Texture Studio (r5, with item states r10)
Pixel editor on a plain canvas (layers, undo/redo, palettes and ramps, selection, tiling and 3D item preview, onion skin for animated textures), library browsing, **Style DNA** applied across a whole mod (palette ramps, outline rule, noise), AI edits arrive as non-destructive candidates with before/after diffs, reference-image-to-spec through a vision model, asset history, the quality rubric (palette size, contrast, edge density, banding, transparency policy) as a review screen. Item-model **context switcher** (hotbar, dropped, first/third person, item frame, head) and a **state scrubber** (idle, pull 1-3, aim, reload). Server pieces: `lib/cyrus/textures` (renderer, pack builder, per-version validation), `lib/cyrus/texture-library` (82 templates, 281 items), `/api/cyrus/assets/v1/*`. The vanilla-lookalike check is a stub.

## Sound Studio (r9)
Waveform editor (zoom, regions, trim, fade, gain, pitch/time, layering, spectrum, loudness and true-peak readouts), library search by tag, synthesis presets, per-event mob/item sound sets, **subtitle keys**, non-destructive edit recipes, server-side **mono Ogg Vorbis** export (mono = positional; stereo = constant volume), asset history with waveform diffs. New namespaced sound keys are played by the plugin and the vanilla base mob is silenced (never override vanilla keys globally). Rendering path: web -> worker -> node-2 relay (`CYRUS_SOUND_RENDER=ssh`/relay vars), never from the web process. The owner's proprietary library is **not cleared** (`CYRUS_SOUND_LIBRARY_CLEARED` off): customer builds get synthesised sounds only until the owner documents sources and clears it. See [04 assets](04-assets-and-library.md).

## Model Studio
Layer 1 (`lib/cyrus/modelstudio`, 63 files): three.js viewport (one orbit camera `projectOrbit`/`rayFromOrbit`, one clock `PlaybackClock`), paint on the model, scene clock, per-node overrides and overlays (hooks for motion/effects), Minecraft display contexts moved out of the core. Layer 2 (cuboid + bone editor): cuboid/bone editing, a game-neutral timeline core, editor saves stored as drafts (`CyrusModelDraft`, `surface` = paint/editor/mesh; manual SQL **not applied**). Integration (r30): one current-creature rule for both studios and the build sync, creature paint compiled into the delivered BetterModel skin (byte-identical, real 26.2 flight). Layer 3 (`/studio/mesh`): `MeshEditDoc` v1 with one op log, part transforms with snap and limits, per-channel lossless layers and UV island fills, template sliders validated by the meshgen schema, block-out + rebuild with 0 tokens, legal badge from the ledger, export picker from asset profiles (**Minecraft = no**: no converter exists), plan gate server side. Known: meshgen glbs are unwrapped per part so channel fills on overlapping UV islands also land on other parts (the studio says so); layer-1/3 UIs follow unreviewed mockups; not linked from the Assets tab.

## Motion, Config, designers
- **Motion panel** (r27): rig tree, state machine + variables, scripted events, the browser-run motion core (`simulate`, software `renderFrame`), transport + timeline (state band, keys where played, cue lanes, scrubbing), Knobs (preset params = the edit), Export (Minecraft caps, lowered program, what is left out), Checks; preset browser.
- **Config and Stats Studio** (r23): groups, search, presets, sliders with the balanced band + unit fields, reset, warnings, "send to server" (delivery), values-only revisions. Plan: [config/CONFIG-PLAN.md](config/CONFIG-PLAN.md). The Config studio also edits designer values; the two should share one entry point later.
- **Designers** (r27, `lib/cyrus/designer/studio`, `/api/cyrus/designer/v1/**`: check, save as revision, autosave draft, simulate, settings-only plan): Item Designer (header, assets chips, display-context preview, When -> Only if -> Do ability graph, 5 budget meters, validator error codes, parameters), Menu + Quest (slot grid, inspector, try-it sample player through the real CostCharger, owner-editable shop list, quest chain/branches), Boss + encounter (phase ladder on the health bar, attack inspector, arena top-down, fight simulator). Save = a new `edited` revision; `CYRUS_DESIGNER_BUILDS` makes it reach a server. Structural editing is basic (templates, JSON view, no drag and drop). Item icons are labelled placeholders (open question).

## Customer-app screens (r31, r39)
Mod Packs + conflicts (acknowledge every warning), Import (attestation, allowlist, never "safe"), Data packs + worldgen (read-only, per-version re-validation, restart banner, rollback states), library browser (all kinds, licence tier, Minecraft fit, plan gate), Use in project (503 until the library backend is on). See [06 portals](06-portals.md).

## Forge / modules (pending)
The "forge" is the core graph on the studio canvas (the owner's v5 handoff). Branch `feature/cyrus-r45-structure` (running 2026-10-11) adds: show only what the game/version can use (capability manifest; lock by plan), sub-branches inside the graph for each mod's parts, and **modules inside ONE mod** (scoped edit/build per module or whole; dependency and cross-reference validation; per-module revisions, tests and spend; export a module as its own mod), distinct from Mod Packs; ModSpec v2 modules. **Unmerged at the time of writing; nothing here is verified.** Update this section when r45 lands.

## Design language
Studios live inside `.cyrus-root.nx-dark-island` (scoped CSS, `cy5-*` keyframes, `cy-*` tokens; `test/cyrus.test.ts` fails if a selector is unscoped). The portal's own sidebar and top bar stay. History of the owner's design rejections and what was learned: [10 decisions](10-decisions.md).

# 04 Assets and the library

Everything about *content Cyrus can use or ship*: legal rules, the catalog, ingestion, the owner's sound library, the Minecraft reference policy, motion/effect assets, the library backend, and takedown/filters. Staging data is **not in git, not served, not in the database**; it lives on disk (`/tank/cyrus-library-staging`).

## Legal ledger and asset classes (`lib/cyrus/assets3d/ledger.ts`, client-safe copy used by server and studios)
| Class | Meaning | Store beyond job | Add to library | Redistribute | Deliverable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user-original` | authored by the user in a studio | yes | yes | yes | full |
| `ai-generated-for-user` | made by Cyrus for the user | yes | yes | yes | full |
| `platform-library` | Nxeon-owned or CC0 only | yes | yes | yes | full |
| `third-party-licensed` | uploaded/imported under someone else's licence | yes | **no** | no | full |
| `game-derived` | derived from a game's own files | **no** | **no** | **no** | delta-only |

The rule: **game-derived content never outlives its job, never enters a library, never ships.** `libraryEligible()` allows automatic contribution only for content authored inside Cyrus (provenance source `user`/`ai`/`library`) with an empty `derivedFrom`; uploads, imports, templates and anything derived from other bytes are never eligible. Eligible is not published: content filters and the Terms grant still gate publication. Every manifest carries provenance (`source`, `derivedFrom`) and a legal class; a Model Studio badge shows it.

## Licence rules (owner decisions)
- **CC0 only** in the community library; **no creator credit** (CC-BY excluded, so there is no attribution burden); "usable by anyone" semantics for contributed assets are an open decision (does it include "Use in project").
- Every upstream source was checked on its own page; an aggregator's blanket "CC0" was not relied on. Per-source/pack quotes and exclusions are in `LICENCE-LEDGER.csv` (about 670 rows) and `_lic/` in staging.
- Excluded and kept aside: 4,132 CC-BY rows; the Quaternius Bestiary (new no-redistribution licence); Mixamo/CMU (terms); 88 PVFX Foundry rows (CC0 only by description text); CC-BY-NC and Sampling+ FSD50K clips. Rejected or unreadable sources (Freesound direct, BigSoundBank, OpenGameArt bulk, NASA 3D, ShareTextures/Texturecan/Poly Pizza) are listed in the ledger with quotes.
- Sound audio is **never in git and never served raw**; the proprietary library is served only when cleared.

## Staging layout and ingestion (r-J, `/tank/cyrus-library-staging`)
`kenney/ quaternius/ kaykit/ polyhaven/ ambientcg/ khronos/ smithsonian/ thebasemesh/ game-icons/ sound/ motion/` hold source packs; `catalog.jsonl` and the `catalog-*.jsonl` family hold per-asset rows (publishable, excluded-ccby, excluded-pending-licence, proprietary-sfx, motion2-publishable); `catalog-v2/` holds the enriched entries (`entries3-staged-cc0.jsonl` = 62,777 entries, CC0 + owner proprietary, 56.5% fully described, 62,444 published / 43 held / 290 removed; flags 422 trademark, 87 violence, 49 real-weapon); `_quarantine/`, `_raw/`, `_lic/`, `tools/` (ingest scripts, e.g. `si2.py` resumes the Smithsonian pull, `fsd2.py` the FSD50K pull). Tools are deterministic and idempotent.

Staged now (CC0): about 62k rows: 10,278 models, 2,946 PBR sets, 1,430 HDRIs, 38,464 Kenney sprites (inflated), 2,752 textures, 127 decals, about 6,000 sounds including the owner's 2,964-file proprietary library. Open: Smithsonian 199 of 2,326 verified models staged; FSD50K download slow (keep the CC0 half only); NASA models and Warfork sounds need the owner's call; 10 sounds failed to decode; thumbnails for about 18k assets before any AI tagging; numeric pack folder names (1-10) carry no description.

## Catalog v2 (`lib/cyrus/library/v2`, `CyrusCatalog*` tables)
Each asset has a content-hash id `cat:<sha256>`, kind (model, PBR set, texture, sprite, HDRI, decal, sound, music, plus motion/effect kinds: flipbook, particle-texture, animation-clip, animated-model, motion-preset, effect-preset), title, description (<=140), controlled tags + up to 8 free tags, one primary and up to 3 secondary categories, measured descriptors (audio duration/intensity/pitch band/loopable/channels; texture size/palette/transparency/tileable/style), game fit, licence tier and provenance. **Stage A (no AI)** describes 54.7% fully (models 98.7%, HDRIs/decals 100%, PBR 81%, sprites 41.6%, plain textures 18%); AI tagging of the remainder (26,863 assets, about 146k input + 112k output tokens, likely cents) is recommended only for the roughly 4.5k non-sprite leftovers and needs thumbnails first and an owner tier/cap decision. Search: SQLite v2 index (posting lists, one SQL statement) worst 92 ms on 61k entries with exact parity to the memory index; Postgres medians 9-160 ms. Catalog tools in builds (`CYRUS_CATALOG_TOOLS` + `CYRUS_CATALOG_INDEX`, off = byte-identical) let the model `catalog_search`/`catalog_get` over a pre-gated pool; picks are recorded as ModSpec library slots and not shipped.

## Library backend (r26, `lib/cyrus/library/backend`, all OFF)
Content-addressed object store (local or S3, caps, 30-day retention), lazy deterministic derivatives (thumb, preview-ogg, glb-opt, bundle), signed 5-minute viewer-scoped URLs (raw audio never; proprietary only when cleared), **automatic contribution** with strict filters and a hold queue, exact/near dedupe (image dhash, audio envelope, glb facts, motion JSON), reports and **takedown** (a legal report or 3 reporters holds; takedown removes now, purges derivatives, marks dependents; **dependent mods keep building from their own copy, not plan-gated**), Use in project (`cat:<sha256>` slot + project copy + dependents record; sounds Saka+, visuals All models; keeping never gated), Postgres catalog + importer (60,970 entries into a throwaway Postgres in 469 s, re-run 4.7 s with 0 written), admin read model. Tables `CyrusLibraryDerivative/Use/Report/Moderation/Fingerprint`, `CyrusLegalCase` (DMCA cases + counter-notice, r40). Not wired: Nxeon-side project-copy sink for everything, studio contribute hooks beyond the Texture Studio, ffmpeg/gltf-transform on node-2.

## Takedown, filters, moderation (r32, r40)
Content filters: trademark list (a stub until the owner supplies one; editable in admin), real-weapon names (hold vs flag is an open decision), violence/extremist/drugs/adult, text-only today (no NFKC/confusables or pixel/audio classifier: open item O-8). r32 fixed: one account could mass-hold assets with copyright reports (now 5 auto-holds per reporter per 24 h) and takedown now also holds stored near-copies. Admin (`/admin/cyrus/library/*`): hold-queue decisions, near-duplicates, contribution stats, filter-list editor, DMCA case log. A lawyer must review the Terms licence grant for automatic contribution before launch.

## The owner's proprietary SFX library
514 MP3s first (board upload), later 2,964 files in `/tank/cyrus-library-incoming` (zip CRC-verified, unzipped under staging `sound/nxeon-proprietary`). Licence (per the bundle's own PDF): licensor Excelerator.tech, non-transferable; **modifying and using in games is allowed; distributing or making the files available alone or in a bundle is prohibited**. Therefore: customers hear it only through processed in-game use after the owner clears it; `CYRUS_SOUND_LIBRARY_CLEARED` stays off, so customer builds get synthesised sounds only. Needed: confirm Excelerator.tech is the owner's, document the source per file group, write the customer-facing sound licence, per-pack licence documents, a second copy off the single `tank` disk. Catalog review: the generated `sound-library-catalog.md` (10 categories: weapons, doors/mechanisms, creatures/voices, crowd, music/stingers, impacts, movement, UI/alerts, magic/energy, environment).

## Minecraft reference and "bring your own game assets" (policy)
The owner supplied Minecraft game archives. They are **game-derived reference, private**. Rules: never in the community library, never served, never in git, never summarised in these docs; at most a *distilled* private index of ids/names/hashes for validating references (branch `feature/cyrus-r42-mcref`, **pending**), and a "bring your own game assets" flow where a user's own copy is processed for that user only (game-derived class: stored for the job only, deliverable as a delta). One archive's provenance is unknown and needs the owner. The Mojang EULA / usage-guideline question is parked but now matters; Cyrus never redistributes vanilla assets (the Mods installer treats vanilla as unredistributable).

## Motion and effects asset program
Staged under `motion/` (catalog `catalog-motion.jsonl`, 1,972 rows; ledger 50 rows): KayKit character animations (CC0, 173 clips), Quaternius Universal Animation Library (172 rows), animated models from the 3D ingest (390 glb with 5,786 embedded clips, heavy duplication), OpenGameArt effects (127 sheets, 37 frame sequences; 3 CC-BY pages kept in a separate tier), OGA Quaternius creature FBX (30 FBX, 94 clip stacks; needs an FBX-to-glTF converter that does not exist on the box). Pass 2 published 1,895 CC0 rows: 297 procedural flipbook sheets in 14 families, 240 converted clips, 39 authored rigs, about 1,400 OGA/itch rows. Gaps (water, doors, effect presets) are authored procedurally (150+ flipbooks) and as motion core presets. The six motion/effect kinds are in catalog v2; `entries2-staged-cc0.jsonl` still has old rows as `texture` until stage A is re-run.

## Where the numbers come from
Reports `J-asset-library-ingest.md`, `M-catalog-v2.md`, `S-motion-assets.md`, `S2-motion-assets.md`, `W-library-backend.md`, `sound-library-catalog.md` in `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/` (index: [11 history](11-history.md)); code and tests: [reference/modules.md](reference/modules.md), [reference/tests.md](reference/tests.md).
E

# 04 Assets and the library

Everything about *content Cyrus can use or ship*: legal rules, the catalog, ingestion, the owner's sound library, the Minecraft reference policy, motion/effect assets, the library backend, and takedown/filters. Staging data is **not in git, not served, not in the database**; it lives on disk (`/tank/cyrus-library-staging`).

## Legal ledger and asset classes (`lib/cyrus/assets3d/ledger.ts`, client-safe copy used by server and studios)
| Class | Meaning | Store beyond job | Add to library | Redistribute | Deliverable |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `user-original` | authored by the user in a studio | yes | yes | yes | full |
| `ai-generated-for-user` | made by Cyrus for the user | yes | yes | yes | full |
| `platform-library` | Nxeon-owned or CC0 only | yes | yes | yes | full |
| `third-party-licensed` | uploaded/imported under someone else's licence | yes | **no** | no | full |
| `game-derived` | derived from a game's own files | **no** | **no** | **no** | delta-only |

The rule: **game-derived content never outlives its job, never enters a library, never ships.** `libraryEligible()` allows automatic contribution only for content authored inside Cyrus (provenance source `user`/`ai`/`library`) with an empty `derivedFrom`; uploads, imports, templates and anything derived from other bytes are never eligible. Eligible is not published: content filters and the Terms grant still gate publication. Every manifest carries provenance (`source`, `derivedFrom`) and a legal class; a Model Studio badge shows it.

## Licence rules (owner decisions)
- **CC0 only** in the community library; **no creator credit** (CC-BY excluded, so there is no attribution burden); "usable by anyone" semantics for contributed assets are an open decision (does it include "Use in project").
- Every upstream source was checked on its own page; an aggregator's blanket "CC0" was not relied on. Per-source/pack quotes and exclusions are in `LICENCE-LEDGER.csv` (about 670 rows) and `_lic/` in staging.
- Excluded and kept aside: 4,132 CC-BY rows; the Quaternius Bestiary (new no-redistribution licence); Mixamo/CMU (terms); 88 PVFX Foundry rows (CC0 only by description text); CC-BY-NC and Sampling+ FSD50K clips. Rejected or unreadable sources (Freesound direct, BigSoundBank, OpenGameArt bulk, NASA 3D, ShareTextures/Texturecan/Poly Pizza) are listed in the ledger with quotes.
- Sound audio is **never in git and never served raw**; the proprietary library is served only when cleared.

## Staging layout and ingestion (r-J, `/tank/cyrus-library-staging`)
`kenney/ quaternius/ kaykit/ polyhaven/ ambientcg/ khronos/ smithsonian/ thebasemesh/ game-icons/ sound/ motion/` hold source packs; `catalog.jsonl` and the `catalog-*.jsonl` family hold per-asset rows (publishable, excluded-ccby, excluded-pending-licence, proprietary-sfx, motion2-publishable); `catalog-v2/` holds the enriched entries (`entries3-staged-cc0.jsonl` = 62,777 entries, CC0 + owner proprietary, 56.5% fully described, 62,444 published / 43 held / 290 removed; flags 422 trademark, 87 violence, 49 real-weapon); `_quarantine/`, `_raw/`, `_lic/`, `tools/` (ingest scripts, e.g. `si2.py` resumes the Smithsonian pull, `fsd2.py` the FSD50K pull). Tools are deterministic and idempotent.

Staged now (CC0): about 62k rows: 10,278 models, 2,946 PBR sets, 1,430 HDRIs, 38,464 Kenney sprites (inflated), 2,752 textures, 127 decals, about 6,000 sounds including the owner's 2,964-file proprietary library. Open: Smithsonian 199 of 2,326 verified models staged; FSD50K download slow (keep the CC0 half only); NASA models and Warfork sounds need the owner's call; 10 sounds failed to decode; thumbnails for about 18k assets before any AI tagging; numeric pack folder names (1-10) carry no description.

## Catalog v2 (`lib/cyrus/library/v2`, `CyrusCatalog*` tables)
Each asset has a content-hash id `cat:<sha256>`, kind (model, PBR set, texture, sprite, HDRI, decal, sound, music, plus motion/effect kinds: flipbook, particle-texture, animation-clip, animated-model, motion-preset, effect-preset), title, description (<=140), controlled tags + up to 8 free tags, one primary and up to 3 secondary categories, measured descriptors (audio duration/intensity/pitch band/loopable/channels; texture size/palette/transparency/tileable/style), game fit, licence tier and provenance. **Stage A (no AI)** describes 54.7% fully (models 98.7%, HDRIs/decals 100%, PBR 81%, sprites 41.6%, plain textures 18%); AI tagging of the remainder (26,863 assets, about 146k input + 112k output tokens, likely cents) is recommended only for the roughly 4.5k non-sprite leftovers and needs thumbnails first and an owner tier/cap decision. Search: SQLite v2 index (posting lists, one SQL statement) worst 92 ms on 61k entries with exact parity to the memory index; Postgres medians 9-160 ms. Catalog tools in builds (`CYRUS_CATALOG_TOOLS` + `CYRUS_CATALOG_INDEX`, off = byte-identical) let the model `catalog_search`/`catalog_get` over a pre-gated pool; picks are recorded as ModSpec library slots and not shipped.

## Library backend (r26, `lib/cyrus/library/backend`, all OFF)
Content-addressed object store (local or S3, caps, 30-day retention), lazy deterministic derivatives (thumb, preview-ogg, glb-opt, bundle), signed 5-minute viewer-scoped URLs (raw audio never; proprietary only when cleared), **automatic contribution** with strict filters and a hold queue, exact/near dedupe (image dhash, audio envelope, glb facts, motion JSON), reports and **takedown** (a legal report or 3 reporters holds; takedown removes now, purges derivatives, marks dependents; **dependent mods keep building from their own copy, not plan-gated**), Use in project (`cat:<sha256>` slot + project copy + dependents record; sounds Saka+, visuals All models; keeping never gated), Postgres catalog + importer (60,970 entries into a throwaway Postgres in 469 s, re-run 4.7 s with 0 written), admin read model. Tables `CyrusLibraryDerivative/Use/Report/Moderation/Fingerprint`, `CyrusLegalCase` (DMCA cases + counter-notice, r40). Not wired: Nxeon-side project-copy sink for everything, studio contribute hooks beyond the Texture Studio, ffmpeg/gltf-transform on node-2.

## Takedown, filters, moderation (r32, r40)
Content filters: trademark list (a stub until the owner supplies one; editable in admin), real-weapon names (hold vs flag is an open decision), violence/extremist/drugs/adult, text-only today (no NFKC/confusables or pixel/audio classifier: open item O-8). r32 fixed: one account could mass-hold assets with copyright reports (now 5 auto-holds per reporter per 24 h) and takedown now also holds stored near-copies. Admin (`/admin/cyrus/library/*`): hold-queue decisions, near-duplicates, contribution stats, filter-list editor, DMCA case log. A lawyer must review the Terms licence grant for automatic contribution before launch.

## The owner's proprietary SFX library
514 MP3s first (board upload), later 2,964 files in `/tank/cyrus-library-incoming` (zip CRC-verified, unzipped under staging `sound/nxeon-proprietary`). Licence (per the bundle's own PDF): licensor Excelerator.tech, non-transferable; **modifying and using in games is allowed; distributing or making the files available alone or in a bundle is prohibited**. Therefore: customers hear it only through processed in-game use after the owner clears it; `CYRUS_SOUND_LIBRARY_CLEARED` stays off, so customer builds get synthesised sounds only. Needed: confirm Excelerator.tech is the owner's, document the source per file group, write the customer-facing sound licence, per-pack licence documents, a second copy off the single `tank` disk. Catalog review: the generated `sound-library-catalog.md` (10 categories: weapons, doors/mechanisms, creatures/voices, crowd, music/stingers, impacts, movement, UI/alerts, magic/energy, environment).

## Minecraft reference and "bring your own game assets" (policy)
The owner supplied Minecraft game archives. They are **game-derived reference, private**. Rules: never in the community library, never served, never in git, never summarised in these docs; at most a *distilled* private index of ids/names/hashes for validating references (branch `feature/cyrus-r42-mcref`, **pending**), and a "bring your own game assets" flow where a user's own copy is processed for that user only (game-derived class: stored for the job only, deliverable as a delta). One archive's provenance is unknown and needs the owner. The Mojang EULA / usage-guideline question is parked but now matters; Cyrus never redistributes vanilla assets (the Mods installer treats vanilla as unredistributable).

## Motion and effects asset program
Staged under `motion/` (catalog `catalog-motion.jsonl`, 1,972 rows; ledger 50 rows): KayKit character animations (CC0, 173 clips), Quaternius Universal Animation Library (172 rows), animated models from the 3D ingest (390 glb with 5,786 embedded clips, heavy duplication), OpenGameArt effects (127 sheets, 37 frame sequences; 3 CC-BY pages kept in a separate tier), OGA Quaternius creature FBX (30 FBX, 94 clip stacks; needs an FBX-to-glTF converter that does not exist on the box). Pass 2 published 1,895 CC0 rows: 297 procedural flipbook sheets in 14 families, 240 converted clips, 39 authored rigs, about 1,400 OGA/itch rows. Gaps (water, doors, effect presets) are authored procedurally (150+ flipbooks) and as motion core presets. The six motion/effect kinds are in catalog v2; `entries2-staged-cc0.jsonl` still has old rows as `texture` until stage A is re-run.

## Where the numbers come from
Reports `J-asset-library-ingest.md`, `M-catalog-v2.md`, `S-motion-assets.md`, `S2-motion-assets.md`, `W-library-backend.md`, `sound-library-catalog.md` in `/root/agent-notes/cyrus-research/` (index: [11 history](11-history.md)); code and tests: [reference/modules.md](reference/modules.md), [reference/tests.md](reference/tests.md).

# AH: Cyrus platform bundle (r37), 2026-10-11

Branch `feature/cyrus-r37-platform`, worktree `/tank/dev-worktrees/cyrus-r37`, 7 commits (5 parts + docs + fixes) on r2 3c23bfa9d2 (latest r2, merged). Docs: repo
`docs/CYRUS-PLATFORM.md`. Nothing deployed, applied, installed or run against production. No source files moved.

## What was built
1. **Monorepo plan + scaffold.** Target layout (apps/nxeon, apps/cyrus, apps/cyrus-admin, apps/cyrus-site, packages/*).
   `platform/targets.json` holds the rules: what feeds each target and where each file moves. `scripts/platform/depmap.mjs`
   writes `docs/cyrus-platform-depmap.md` (cyrus-core: 508 files, 2 Nxeon imports). `scripts/platform/affected.mjs` maps changed files to
   targets and deploy units. `apps/cyrus-site` holds the live v7 landing plus `publish.sh` (release dirs, atomic symlink
   swap, legacy dir kept as rollback, health check with auto-rollback, dry run unless `--go`). tsconfig gets the
   `@cyrus/core` alias. No workspaces yet (they would change prod `npm install`).
2. **`scripts/ship`** (affected detection, then one locked node-2 gate job: tsc, seam, OpenAPI contract + dual-mode host
   tests, suite; deploys through the unchanged promote-production.sh, promote-cyrus.sh or the site publish; plan only
   without `--go`). **`scripts/promote-cyrus.sh`**: staging first, side-port smoke, atomic cutover, auto-rollback.
   It refuses real runs while Cyrus is embedded, and refuses production without an armed file. Staging spec is in
   `deploy/cyrus/README.md`.
3. **Cloudflare groundwork.** Generated nginx real_ip config with a validated weekly updater, a throwaway-nginx header
   simulation, per-hostname checklist, static-only cache rules, websocket and origin-cert notes, and a runbook with rollback.
   On the app side, three call sites that read the client-written first X-Forwarded-For entry now use `clientIp`.
4. **Data split.** `tables.mjs` derives 42 tables. `split.sh` does plan, trigger freeze, copy, count+checksum verify,
   dual-read and reverse rollback. `CYRUS_DATABASE_URL` switches `nxeonHost.db` (unset = unchanged).
5. **Observability + backups.** `GET /api/cyrus/health`, error hook (scrubbed, deduplicated Discord), cost export,
   uptime list, status page spec, alert rules + checker, nightly encrypted backup script, systemd units.

## Ran (all on throwaway targets)
- Site publish: temp docroot (swap, rollback, health-fail rollback); dry run on /var/www/cyrus.my.
- promote-cyrus: full local simulation (a smoke failure leaves live untouched; an unhealthy cutover rolls back) plus a
  production dry run.
- Real-IP simulation: 6/6 PASS on the primary.
- Data-split selftest on node-2 throwaway DBs: PASS.
- Backup and alert scripts: dry runs only.
- node-2: tsc clean; 2625 tests (Cyrus suite + 11 Nxeon files near the IP code), 0 Cyrus failures. 18 Nxeon failures are pre-existing on r2. Two r2 first-hop-XFF failures now pass.

## Not run
Any nginx, DNS or Cloudflare change. Any production DB command. The backup and alert timers. The remote Cyrus build
(apps/cyrus does not exist yet). The ship `--go` path. Publishing the site.

## Findings
- **Split blocker:** 338 direct Cyrus-table call sites in 55 files outside lib/cyrus still use Nxeon's `db`. A ratchet
lines with 2 Nxeon imports (the seam did its job); the coupling left is in the app layer (apps/cyrus routes: `lib/auth`,
`lib/rate-limit`, `lib/db`; admin pages: `components/ui/primitives`, `lib/db`, `lib/auth`), the worker (22 Nxeon
modules: guest SSH, installers) and tests (`lib/db`, `lib/mods/guest-fs`). 98 Nxeon files import Cyrus code
(components/nx, app/api, app/dashboard most); they switch to package imports.

### Safe scaffold (done now, no source moved)
- `apps/cyrus-site/` with the v7 landing in `src/` (identical to what cyrus.my serves) and `publish.sh` (section 6).
- `platform/targets.json`: deploy targets, which paths feed each (`feeds`), where each file moves (`owners`).
- `scripts/platform/affected.mjs`: changed files -> targets -> deploy units (`--json`, `--units`, `--explain`,
  `--base <ref>`, `--files ...`). Embedded targets (`cyrus`, `cyrus-admin`) collapse into the `nxeon` unit while they are
  still served by the Nxeon app.
- tsconfig: alias `@cyrus/core/*` -> `lib/cyrus/*` (new code may use the package name today; on move day only the alias
  changes) and `apps/cyrus-site` excluded from type-checking. Other aliases (`@cyrus/ui`, `@cyrus/client`) are NOT
  added yet: the seam ratchet only resolves `@/` and relative imports, so an alias into Nxeon-side code would hide
  coupling from it.
- NOT done on purpose: `"workspaces"` in the root package.json. `promote-production.sh` runs `npm install` in
  /opt/nxeon; workspaces would rewrite package-lock.json and create node_modules symlinks in the live tree (see the
  2026-09 worktree node_modules incident). It is added on extraction day together with a regenerated lockfile, built on
  node-2 and promoted like any other change.

### Extraction day (later, one agent alone, after r38-r40 merge)
1. `git mv` per `owners` group, one commit per group, aliases updated in the same commit; seam test + full suite green
   after each. 2. Add workspaces + per-app package.json/next.config; regenerate the lockfile on node-2. 3. Flip
   `cyrus`/`cyrus-admin` `mode` to `standalone` in targets.json; ship then routes them through `promote-cyrus.sh`.
4. Nxeon's Cyrus tab becomes the thin list/status/deep-link view. Each step is its own revertible commit.

## 2. `scripts/ship <nxeon|cyrus|site|all> [--base REF] [--go] [--skip-gates] [--force]`
1. Affected detection (section 1). A named target ships only if the change touches it.
2. Gates as ONE locked job on node-2 (`devhost db push`, then `devhost run --lock -- ...`): `tsc`, the HOST SEAM ratchet
   (`test/cyrus-host-seam.test.ts`), contract tests (`test/cyrus-api-contract.test.ts` = OpenAPI vs Zod, and
   `test/cyrus-host-http.test.ts` = direct vs HTTP host conformance), then the full suite (when the nxeon unit
   deploys) or the Cyrus suite (`test/cyrus-*`, `test/modbuilder*`, `test/platform-*`). The site check runs locally.
3. Builds always happen on node-2 inside the promote scripts. 4. Deploys, each with its own health checks and
   auto-rollback: nxeon unit -> `deploy-staging.sh` then `promote-production.sh` (both unchanged; the commit must be
   /opt/nxeon HEAD); standalone cyrus/cyrus-admin -> `promote-cyrus.sh --env staging` then `--env production`; site ->
   `publish.sh publish --go` with an origin health check (`curl --resolve cyrus.my:443:127.0.0.1`); modbuilder ->
   printed owner action, never automatic.
Without `--go` ship stops after the gates and prints the plan.

### `scripts/promote-cyrus.sh` (dry-run capable, NOT armed)
Phases mirror promote-production.sh: preflight (clean tree; production requires the armed file on the host AND
staging healthy on the same commit) -> build on node-2 (`scripts/cyrus/remote-build-cyrus.sh`: mirror push,
`run-capped.sh prod`, build lock, tarball) -> schema (additive unless `--accept-data-loss`) -> stage release ->
side-port smoke (health paths 200 and `/api/cyrus/health` names the commit) -> atomic `current` symlink swap ->
restart + health -> auto-rollback to the previous release on failure -> worker restart after the web is healthy ->
keep N releases. `--rollback [ID]` any time. Refuses every real run while `cyrus.mode` is `embedded`. Proven by
`test/platform-scripts.test.ts` on a throwaway local "host" (smoke failure leaves live untouched; an unhealthy
cutover rolls back). The remote build is untested until `apps/cyrus` exists. Targets + staging spec:
`deploy/cyrus/README.md`.

## 3. Cloudflare for the Nxeon zones (groundwork, NOT applied)
Files: `deploy/cloudflare/` (nginx `cloudflare-realip.conf` generated, `websocket-keepalive.conf`,
`origin-cert-strict.conf`, `cache-rules.json`, weekly `cf-ips-update.{service,timer}`), `scripts/cloudflare/`
(`update-cf-ips.sh` fetch/validate/render, `--install` = copy + `nginx -t` + reload + restore on failure;
`test-realip.sh` header simulation).

**Real client IP.** nginx `real_ip_header CF-Connecting-IP` trusted only from Cloudflare's ranges (http{} via
conf.d, so every vhost, `limit_req`, allow/deny, logs, `X-Real-IP` and `$proxy_add_x_forwarded_for` get the visitor).
The app needs no knob change: `clientIp` (lib/rate-limit.ts) already takes nginx's hop, which is the restored visitor.
Keep `NXEON_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS=1` (raising it would trust a hop a direct-to-origin caller writes). Fixed three
call sites that still read the client-written first XFF entry: `lib/geo-ip.ts clientIpFromHeaders` (now delegates),
`lib/fulfil-checkout.ts` (Meta CAPI IP), `app/api/cyrus/tokens/return` (its rate limit was a free bucket per
request). Proof: `scripts/cloudflare/test-realip.sh` (throwaway nginx, 127.0.0.2 as edge, 127.0.0.1 as attacker:
6/6 cases PASS on the primary 2026-10-11) and `test/cloudflare-realip.test.ts` (feeds the echoed headers to
`clientIp`). Geo/currency uses geoip-lite on that IP; `CF-IPCountry` is not trusted (a direct caller could forge it).

**Per-hostname readiness** (orange = proxy, grey = DNS only):
| Record | Decision | Why / before switching |
|---|---|---|
| nxeon.cloud, www | orange (second) | after realip installed + ws pings; measure US TTFB before/after |
| admin host (4j3d7gkr2wcbi34), staff host (71e6af2ad905af) | orange (later) or grey | staff-IP allowlists keep working with realip; consider Cloudflare Access |
| staging.nxeon.cloud + staging admin | orange FIRST (pilot) | lowest risk; verify logs/limits show real IPs |
| sites.nxeon.cloud, *.sites (customer sites) | grey until reviewed | customer content, own certs; wildcard proxy is a plan-level decision |
| mail.nxeon.cloud, MX, autodiscover, SPF/DKIM/DMARC TXT, bulk.nxeon.cloud | grey ALWAYS | SMTP/IMAP are not HTTP; mail IP reputation |
| play.nxeon.cloud, *.play.nxeon.cloud, *.playnxeon.com game hosts, valheim.*, free-MC (mc-router) | grey ALWAYS | TCP/UDP game ports; Cloudflare proxies HTTP(S) only |
| playnxeon.com / trynxeon.com apex redirects, revsports.ca | orange ok | pure HTTP redirects |
| *.nxcloud.nxeon.cloud, node/VM hostnames, SSH, Proxmox, panel ports | grey ALWAYS | non-HTTP or non-standard ports, direct admin access |
| dev hosts (flow.*, v2.*, nexion.*) | grey or Access | dev sandboxes; nexion-ui stays stopped (2026-09 incident) |

**Cache:** static only (`cache-rules.json`): bypass first for `/api/`, `/dashboard`, `/admin`, `/studio`, `/sso`,
auth pages, `/.well-known/`, ws paths and any request with `nxeon_session`; cache `/_next/static/` one year
